summary: Beclometasone (beclomethasone dipropionate) is an inhaled corticosteroid for maintenance/prophylactic treatment of asthma in adults and children 4 years and older. It is a potent anti-inflammatory prodrug activated to beclomethasone-17-monopropionate (17-BMP). It is NOT a bronchodilator and is not for acute bronchospasm. Patients should rinse the mouth with water (without swallowing) after each use to reduce oral candidiasis. (Beclometasone is also marketed as nasal sprays and topical/oral formulations; this record reflects the FDA-approved inhalation product.)
indications: Maintenance treatment of asthma as prophylactic therapy in adults and pediatric patients 4 years of age and older

dosage.d: 40, 80, 160, or 320 mcg twice daily (start per prior therapy/severity)
Add ICS, then taper systemic steroid slowly
dosage.n: Risk of impaired adrenal function during transfer

dosage.d: Do not use for relief of acute bronchospasm
dosage.n: Use a short-acting beta-2 agonist for rescue

admin: Rinse mouth with water (do not swallow) after each inhalation to reduce oral thrush
Do not use with a spacer or volume-holding chamber (QVAR Redihaler is breath-actuated)
Shaking the breath-actuated inhaler is not necessary; do not shake with the cap open
Discard when the dose counter reads 0 or after the expiration date
moa: Beclomethasone dipropionate is a corticosteroid with potent anti-inflammatory activity. It is a prodrug rapidly hydrolyzed to the active monoester beclomethasone-17-monopropionate (17-BMP), which has high human glucocorticoid-receptor affinity. Corticosteroids inhibit multiple inflammatory cells (mast cells, eosinophils, lymphocytes, macrophages, neutrophils) and the release of mediators (histamine, eicosanoids, leukotrienes, cytokines), contributing to efficacy in asthma. The precise mechanism in asthma is not fully known.

absolute: Primary treatment of status asthmaticus or acute asthma episodes requiring intensive measures
Known hypersensitivity to beclomethasone dipropionate or any ingredient
relative: Active or quiescent tuberculosis; untreated fungal, bacterial, viral, or parasitic infection; ocular herpes simplex
Patients susceptible to chickenpox or measles (potential severe course)
monitor: Bone mineral density with long-term use

preg: No adequate well-controlled studies, but no published data (including large birth registries) relate inhaled corticosteroids to increased congenital malformations or adverse perinatal outcomes. Poorly controlled asthma carries maternal and fetal risk. Use the lowest effective dose to maintain asthma control.
lact: Inhaled corticosteroids, including beclomethasone, are generally considered compatible with breastfeeding; systemic exposure is low at therapeutic inhaled doses. Monitor the infant.
renal: No specific dosage adjustment for inhaled beclometasone.

moderate: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (e.g., ritonavir, ketoconazole) may increase systemic corticosteroid exposure — use with caution
interactions.diagnostics: Long-term high-dose use may suppress the HPA axis — consider cortisol assessment during stress/transfer from oral steroids.

serious: Hypercorticism and adrenal suppression (especially during transfer from oral steroids or at high doses)
Immunosuppression and risk of serious infection (chickenpox, measles, TB reactivation)

monitoring: Growth (height) in pediatric patients on long-term therapy
Signs of adrenal insufficiency, especially during oral-steroid transfer
Bone mineral density, IOP, and lens with prolonged high-dose use
counsel: This is a controller, not a rescue inhaler — it will not relieve a sudden attack; use your reliever (e.g., albuterol) for that
Rinse your mouth with water and spit out after every use to prevent thrush
Use it every day even when you feel well, for it to work
Tell your doctor if your asthma worsens or your reliever is needed more often
Avoid exposure to chickenpox or measles if not immune; tell your doctor if exposed
Carry a steroid-warning card if on long-term or high-dose therapy
pk: Anti-inflammatory effect builds over days; full benefit in 1-2 weeks
Store per product labeling at room temperature; do not puncture or expose to heat/flame
pearls: Prodrug activated to 17-BMP, which has high glucocorticoid-receptor affinity (~13x dexamethasone in vitro)
Maintenance/prophylactic only — never for acute bronchospasm or status asthmaticus
Always rinse mouth after inhaling to prevent oral candidiasis and dysphonia
QVAR Redihaler is breath-actuated and used WITHOUT a spacer
Taper systemic steroids slowly when transferring to ICS — adrenal-suppression risk
Use the lowest effective dose, especially in children (growth monitoring)
missed: If a dose is missed, take it as soon as remembered, then continue the regular schedule. Do not double the dose. If close to the next dose, skip the missed one.
overdose: Acute overdose of inhaled beclometasone is unlikely to produce clinical problems. Chronic overdosing may cause signs of hypercorticism and HPA-axis suppression. Continue therapy at the recommended dose for asthma control and monitor adrenal function; abrupt cessation of high-dose steroid can precipitate adrenal insufficiency.
